name: financials_list_financial_transaction_transfers
description:
Lists individual Amazon payouts and transfers from posted financial transactions (neonpanel_iceberg.financial_transaction_lines_v1, the ACCRUAL-method source) -- one row per transfer-class transaction.

Covers every service classified under summary_class 'Transfers': disbursements to the bank account (TXN:Transfer), failed disbursements returning funds, and account-level reserve holds/releases. Selection is driven by the classification map, so newly mapped transfer-like services appear automatically.

SIGN CONVENTION: payouts to the bank are NEGATIVE (money leaving the Amazon account balance); failed disbursements and reserve releases are POSITIVE. Amounts are in the row's local currency -- never sum across currencies.

Each row: posted date, direction (subclass, e.g. 'Transfers to bank account'), amount, currency, transaction type/description/status, marketplace, seller, settlement_id (links the payout to its settlement statement in financials_list_amazon_statements), financial_event_group_id, transaction_id.

Use this for accrual-method companies or any posted-date payout timeline. For settlement-statement deposit records (CASH bookkeeping method), use financials_list_amazon_statements instead.

Knowledge base: https://help.neonpanel.com

start_date.description: Optional inclusive start of posted-day range.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive end of posted-day range.

marketplaces.description: Optional marketplace filter: country code ('US'), marketplace name ('Amazon.com'), or marketplace_id.

directions.description: Optional substring filter on direction, e.g. ['bank account'] or ['reserves'].

filters.description: Compatibility alias for query.filters. Prefer query.filters.
